summary: DeFi Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the confirmation of amended By-Law No. 1 and adoption of By-Law No. 2 providing for advance notice requirements, along with materials distributed for the 2026 Annual General and Special Meeting. This is a routine governance filing by a foreign private issuer regarding by-law amendments and annual meeting procedures, with no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change. No deal terms are present; the filing is purely administrative.
